name: LSH
recent: LSH Capital 于 2026 年 10 月 8 日从 ACE 市场转板至主板上市。11 月中旬起，执行副主席 Datuk Lim Keng Guan 与执行董事 Lim Ding Shyong 在闭市期间连续申报增持公司股份。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比增长 13.4%，但净利环比下降 19.5%。
notable: 公司于 2026 年 10 月 8 日完成从 ACE 市场转板至主板上市。
执行副主席 Datuk Lim Keng Guan 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日至 20 日期间多次申报增持股份（间接权益）。
执行董事 Lim Ding Shyong 于 2026 年 11 月 13 日及 18 日申报增持股份（直接权益）。
risks: 最新季度净利同比下滑 42.7%，净利率由 18.7% 降至 13.3%。
董事在闭市期间连续申报交易，相关买卖受上市条例第 14 章闭市期限制约束。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 MYR 112.725 million，环比增长 13.4%，同比下降 7.5%；净利为 MYR 14.974 million，环比下降 19.5%，同比下降 42.7%；净利率为 13.3%，低于上一期的 18.7%。

recent_en: LSH Capital transferred its listing from the ACE Market to the Main Market on 8 October 2026. From mid-November, Executive Vice Chairman Datuk Lim Keng Guan and Executive Director Lim Ding Shyong made a series of filings for share acquisitions during the closed period. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 13.4% QoQ while net profit fell 19.5% QoQ.
notable_en: The company completed its transfer from the ACE Market to the Main Market on 8 October 2026.
Executive Vice Chairman Datuk Lim Keng Guan filed multiple acquisitions of shares (indirect interest) between 13 and 20 November 2026.
Executive Director Lim Ding Shyong filed acquisitions of shares (direct interest) on 13 and 18 November 2026.
risks_en: Latest quarterly net profit fell 42.7% YoY, with net margin declining from 18.7% to 13.3%.
Directors made consecutive filings for dealings during the closed period, which is subject to Chapter 14 closed-period restrictions.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 112.725 million, up 13.4% QoQ but down 7.5% YoY; net profit was MYR 14.974 million, down 19.5% QoQ and 42.7% YoY; net margin was 13.3% versus 18.7% in the prior period.
